name: studio-bundle
description: Entropy Studio's example addon bundle (terrain, water, FPS-RPG, tower defense, and more)
author: Alex Woodman <alexthegoodman@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/index.ts > dist/bundle.js
scripts.build-daw: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/daw_synth_addon.ts > dist/daw.js
scripts.build-fft-water: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/fft_water_addon.ts > dist/fft_water.js
scripts.build-fft-river: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/fft_river_water_addon.ts > dist/fft_river.js
scripts.build-light-hive: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/light_hive_addon.ts > dist/light_hive.js
